emphasis_points: Convey pet comfort, supportive cushioning, and durable upholstery or wooden frame structure based strictly on provided material specs.
Highlight practical maintenance features (such as removable/washable fabric covers or water-resistant bases) when stated in source data.
Describe resting surface stability and floor footprint as a dedicated resting spot within the room.
avoid_list: Do not claim suitability for specific pet breeds, weights, or sizes unless explicitly stated in source data.
Do not claim orthopedic or veterinary benefits unless verified in product specifications.
Do not invent scratch-proof or chew-resistant properties not listed in source attributes.
tone_notes: Practical, reassuring, and grounded in concrete material qualities and maintenance features.
